% Converted, ltx-talk. C-ALERTBLOCK workaround applied: alertblock/exampleblock
% defined via tcolorbox with a plain MANDATORY brace argument -- NOT the
% d<>m + [{#2}] wrapper that silently renders the title as a literal "[".
% Verified 2026-08-12 against ltx-talk 0.5.3 / TeX Live 2026: clean compile,
% both titles render correctly (see compromises.md C-ALERTBLOCK).
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard=a-4, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}

\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{cadmiumgreen}{rgb}{0.0, 0.42, 0.24}
\usepackage{tcolorbox}
\newtcolorbox{alertblock}[1]{
  title={#1}, fonttitle=\bfseries,
  colback=red!8!white, colframe=red!70!black,
  left=4pt, right=4pt, top=2pt, bottom=2pt,
}
\newtcolorbox{exampleblock}[1]{
  title={#1}, fonttitle=\bfseries,
  colback=cadmiumgreen!8!white, colframe=cadmiumgreen,
  left=4pt, right=4pt, top=2pt, bottom=2pt,
}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}
  \begin{alertblock}{Key result}
    The main finding.
  \end{alertblock}
  \begin{exampleblock}{Worked example}
    Some example text.
  \end{exampleblock}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
